title: One-point matter PDFs beyond TopHat filters
summary: We study the one-point probability distribution function (PDF) for matter densities averaged with an arbitrary spherically symmetric window function. The PDF is analytically modeled within the path integral framework, enabling a non-perturbative description of large-scale structure. It contains a leading order contribution controlled by the spherically symmetric gravitational collapse dynamics, as well as an order-one factor arising from aspherical fluctuations.
